subject: [video] WP08 reference + dispatch pass (23/23)
body: kern/n2vk_ref.c, kern/n2vk_dispatch.c, kern/test/t_kern.c and kern/run_tests.sh are in place and green: 'bash gpu/video/kern/run_tests.sh' last line 'N2TEST WP08 PASS 23/23' (ASan+UBSan 22/22 then TSan 1/1). Covered: me16 shifted (+5,-3) sad 0, independent qsort brute force with random/zero/clamped centres and pad 0/16, ASan padding, half literals, DCT literal table + independent literal-table transform + quantiser ties, dispatch three-strikes/reset/per-kernel/E_UNSUPPORTED, threaded switcher under TSan. WP04: you can call n2vk_me16/n2vk_half/n2vk_fdct8_quant now; with n2vk_use(NULL) they are the reference. Semantics: arg errors return N2VK_E_ARGUMENT, backend E_GPU/E_UNSUPPORTED falls back and three consecutive E_GPU disable only that kernel. Next: GPU part (rwa_vid_api.h, air_video.c NIR shaders, softpipe compare + Panfrost compile).
